sections.label: Call to legislate FWAs
sections.summary: The speaker reiterates a call for the Government to legislate the right to FWAs for all workers, beyond guidelines and advisories.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Through this Adjournment Motion, I wish to reiterate my call for the Government to legislate the right to FWAs for all workers and go beyond guidelines, advisories and moral suasion.

sections.label: Decline in firms offering FWAs
sections.summary: Statistics show the proportion of firms offering at least one scheduled FWA fell from 90.5% in 2021 to 71.4% in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: A CNA commentary published in February 2023 suggested as much, with the title being, “After all this talk about flexible work, why are employers insisting on returning to the office full-time?” Based on statistics from MOM’s Conditions of Employment 2022 report published in May 2023, it appears that the lifting of safe management measures meant the lifting of FWAs for a not insignificant proportion of firms, where the proportion of firms offering at least one scheduled FWA fell from 90.5% in 2021 to 71.4% in 2022, while the number of firms that did not offer any FWAs at all jumped from 9.5% in 2021 to 28.6% in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: While MOM is hopeful that "the provision of FWAs is likely to continue to remain high, above pre-COVID-19 levels", only 50.3% of firms indicated that they are likely to continue to provide FWAs in the next 12 months, with 33.5% somewhat likely and 16.2% of firms not likely to do so, suggesting that the proportion of firms offering FWAs will, in all likelihood, continue to decline post-COVID-19.

sections.label: Record low fertility rate
sections.summary: The total fertility rate is at a record low of 1.04 for 2022, and a poll found 39% did not want a child due to career and lifestyle impact.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: If we need another reason to legislate FWAs, we need to look no further than the other aspect of productivity, where our total fertility rate (TFR) is now at a record low of 1.04 for 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: According to a CNA and YouGov poll published this year, 39% of respondents did not want to have a child as it would have an impact on their career and lifestyle.

sections.label: Family caregivers' caregiving hours
sections.summary: A 2023 study of 200 family caregivers found the average caregiver holds a full-time job and spends another 6.7 hours daily on caregiving.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: According to a 2023 study of 200 family caregivers by the Palliative Care Centre for Excellence in Research and Education, the average caregiver holds a full-time job and, on top of that, spends another 6.7 hours per day on caregiving!

sections.label: Women's labour force participation
sections.summary: Women's labour force participation rate rose to 47% in 2022, compared with 77% for males in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: While the labour force participation rate for women has increased over the years to 47% in 2022, this is still in contrast to that for males at 77% in 2022.

sections.label: Voluntary FWA compliance, upcoming guidelines
sections.summary: Compliance with the tripartite standard on FWAs is voluntary, but Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangements requiring fair consideration of requests will launch in 2024.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Despite the sheer demand for FWAs among employees and the multitude of benefits that it brings to all workers and, in particular, certain groups of workers, such as parents, caregivers and PWDs, there is no legal imperative for employers to offer them, as compliance with the tripartite standard on FWAs is completely voluntary.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: Nevertheless, I understand that work has since started on crafting the Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangements, whereby employers must "fairly and properly" consider employee requests for FWAs when it is launched in 2024.

sections.label: Call for FWA legislation
sections.summary: A Member calls on the Government to enact legislation providing FWAs for all employees, beyond guidelines and moral admonitions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: (In Mandarin): Through this Adjournment Motion, I would like to call on the Government to enact legislation to provide for FWAs for all employees and to go beyond the use of general guidelines, announcements and moral admonitions in the implementation process.

sections.label: Companies offering FWAs fall
sections.summary: The proportion of companies offering at least one FWA fell from 90.5% in 2021 to 71.4% in 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In 2021, the proportion of companies offering at least one FWA fell from 90.5% to 71.4% in 2022.

sections.label: Birth rate new low
sections.summary: In 2022, the birth rate fell to a new low of 1.04.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: In 2022, our birth rate fell to a new low of 1.04.

sections.label: Sustained regular FWA proportion
sections.summary: The proportion of employers offering FWAs on a sustained, regular basis was 71% in 2022, higher than 53% in 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: The proportion of employers offering FWAs on a sustained, regular basis in 2022 was 71%, much higher than 53% in 2019.

sections.label: Productivity Solutions Grant for FWAs
sections.summary: Companies can tap the Productivity Solutions Grant to redesign jobs and make FWAs part of their productivity strategy.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Companies can also tap on the Productivity Solutions Grant to redesign jobs and make FWAs part of the company’s strategy to improve overall productivity.

sections.label: Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests
sections.summary: Employers are encouraged to see FWAs as a competitive advantage, and Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests will be introduced in 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: We encourage employers to see how FWAs can benefit their businesses as a competitive advantage, facilitate employer-employee communication so that mutually beneficial arrangements can be found and, most importantly, maintain workplace trust.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: It is in this spirit that we are introducing the Tripartite Guidelines on FWA Requests in 2024, which will set norms and expectations on how employees can make requests for FWAs and use them responsibly, and how employers can manage requests for FWAs properly and fairly.

sections.label: UK flexible work take-up
sections.summary: UK's right-to-request law since 2003 did not significantly change FWA take-up, except telecommuting during the pandemic, and FWAs alone are not a silver bullet.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: In the case of the UK, which implemented a right-to-request FWA legislation since 2003, the actual take-up of FWAs did not change significantly in the past decade, with the exception of telecommuting during the pandemic.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: Even as we rally tripartite efforts to make FWAs more accessible at the workplace, FWAs, on their own, are not the silver bullet to achieving the larger goal of work-life harmony.

sections.label: Practical approach to FWA barriers
sections.summary: Helping employees access FWAs requires a practical, enabling approach that addresses barriers at each workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang)
sentences.text: If we want to help employees have access to FWAs, we need a practical, enabling approach that addresses barriers at each workplace.
